scenes.description: Opening shot with abstract digital particles flowing in a dark background.
scenes.visuals: Glowing lines, futuristic particles assembling like data streams.

scenes.description: Showcase of a website coming together piece by piece (UI blocks sliding in, menus appearing, smooth animations).
scenes.visuals: Floating 3D panels, animated web layout assembling on screen.

scenes.description: App screens rotating and stacking neatly, demonstrating sleek mobile UI design.
scenes.visuals: Multiple app mockups spinning and arranging into a grid.

scenes.description: Digital marketing visuals - analytics graphs rising, social media icons glowing, ads displaying.
scenes.visuals: Animated graphs, social icons orbiting, ad popups with smooth animations.

scenes.description: All previous visuals merge into a single frame, morphing into a futuristic glowing logo.
scenes.visuals: Website, app, and marketing visuals collapse into one central light source.

scenes.description: Company name 'STARTIFIE' builds letter by letter with glowing digital effects.
scenes.visuals: Letters assemble with sparks, futuristic glow, and final shine effect.
